summary: ITERATION 10 — COA + Pentarchy branding/polish verification against the preview app https://apeps-mobile-demo.preview.emergentagent.com (390x844, customer tracktest.ap3p@mailinator.com / TrackTest2026!) and against the backend proxy. ALL REVIEW ITEMS PASS code-level + runtime-level except TWO user-content caveats (see below). Backend: 4/4 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_glp_coa_proxy.py — (a) /api/glp/health 200 secret_configured upstream_reachable, (b) GET /api/glp/products/277/coa without token → 404 (upstream rest_no_route, plugin v2.3.0 — expected), (c) with customer bearer token → 404 rest_no_route (plugin v2.3.0 doesn't register the route yet — expected per review), (d) /api/glp/catalogue items have NO `coa` key (mapCoa→null → CoaSection returns null). Proxy route exists in /app/backend/glp_proxy.py lines 215-217 and forwards correctly. PHP: php -l /app/backend/connector-src/glp-app-connector/includes/{coa.php,manage.php,emails.php} all pass with no syntax errors. Frontend (customer): login 200+token, home-screen renders with hero text 'Members-only stock, while it lasts' + CTA 'Browse products', home-support-card shows 'thepentarchy@proton.me'. No visible 'Vial'/'AP3P'/'Apeps'/'GLP' on home. Shop tab top bar reads 'Available now' (confirmed via screenshot), tab testIDs resolve to tab-home/tab-shop/tab-search/tab-orders/tab-account. Product /product/277 renders product-screen with product-price £23.00, product-stock-badge 'Only 7 left', add-to-basket-button, product-gallery-image fallback (277 has no WP image). testID product-coa-section is CORRECTLY ABSENT (0 occurrences) because the live plugin v2.3.0 does not emit a `coa` field. 'Ask a question' text is NOT present anywhere on the product screen. Account /account renders account-screen with: no 'Legal & Policies', no 'Help & contact'; a 'CONTACT' section whose single row testID account-contact-email shows 'Email us | thepentarchy@proton.me'. Basket→checkout flow: add-to-basket adds, basket renders proceed-checkout-button, /checkout renders place-order-button — place-order was NOT pressed. CAVEAT 1 — SHOP page shows the WooCommerce category chip 'Vials' (the WP category still is literally named 'Vials'). Similarly the product detail screen shows the category eyebrow 'VIALS' (uppercase, auto-cast from category name). This is customer-visible 'Vial' text and the ONLY place 'Vial' leaks into the customer UI. It is NOT fixable in app code without either (a) renaming the WooCommerce category on WP from 'Vials' to e.g. 'Products' / 'Compounds' / 'Research chemicals', or (b) adding a client-side category label-override in catalogue mapper. CAVEAT 2 — Account 'App → Data source' badge says 'MOCK DATA' even though the app is actually running against live GLP (EXPO_PUBLIC_DATA_SOURCE=glp). The ternary at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/account.tsx:99-100 is `activeDataSource === 'live' ? 'LIVE' : 'MOCK DATA'` — it does not account for the 'glp' provider. Cosmetic/misleading. CODE REVIEW of new COA pieces: all 7 files inspected (see critical_code_review_comments) — correct, defensive and consistent. One pre-existing issue carries over from iteration_9 (nested <button> hydration warning on ProductCard favourite buttons inside rails — not introduced by COA work). NO orders placed, NO labels uploaded, NO staff mutations attempted.

issues: Customer-visible 'Vials' text leaks via the WooCommerce category name on prod WP. Shop tab shows category filter chip 'Vials'; product detail screen shows uppercase 'VIALS' eyebrow (styles.category textTransform:'uppercase'). This is the ONLY surface still exposing 'Vial' to customers. Fix: rename the WP product category 'Vials' to a Pentarchy-neutral name (e.g. 'Compounds' or 'Research'), OR add a sanitiser in /app/frontend/src/api/glp/catalogue.ts mapProduct().categories to rewrite the known-bad names. Reference: /app/frontend/app/product/[id].tsx:172-173, /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/shop.tsx (category chip list).

'App → Data source' badge shows 'MOCK DATA' even when EXPO_PUBLIC_DATA_SOURCE=glp (live). The ternary `activeDataSource === 'live' ? 'LIVE' : 'MOCK DATA'` doesn't recognise the 'glp' provider. Suggest: badge should read 'LIVE' when activeDataSource !== 'mock' (or add an explicit 'GLP' branch). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/account.tsx:99-100.

action_items: ONLY if the user wants a truly Vial-free customer UI: rename the WooCommerce product category 'Vials' on prod WP (Products → Categories), OR add a category-name sanitiser in /app/frontend/src/api/glp/catalogue.ts mapProduct to rewrite 'Vials' → 'Compounds' (or whatever the user prefers). Right now 'Vials' appears as a filter chip on /shop and as the category eyebrow on the product detail screen — this is user-controlled data, not a code bug.
Cosmetic polish: update /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/account.tsx:99-100 to show 'LIVE' when activeDataSource is 'glp' (currently falls through to 'MOCK DATA' making the live production app look mocked).

FYI: COA frontend+backend wiring is correct and ready. When the WP operator installs plugin v2.4.0 (COA PHP already present in /app/backend/connector-src/glp-app-connector/includes/coa.php, php -l clean), upstream GET /glp/v1/products/{id}/coa and the catalogue `coa` field will start returning real data and product-coa-section will appear automatically on products that have a COA. No further app code changes needed.

FYI: pre-existing nested <button> hydration warning on home/shop rails (favourite button nested inside rail card Pressable) is still present — unchanged by this iteration, carried over from iteration_9's action_items.
critical_code_review_comments: src/components/product/CoaSection.tsx — correct early-return `if (!coa) return null;` means the row is HIDDEN on products with no COA (matches the review spec exactly). URL vs file branch is clean; synchronous `window.open('', '_blank')` for PDFs correctly dodges popup blockers on web. ActivityIndicator while fetching, inline error on failure (testID product-coa-error), full-screen image Modal for JPG/PNG with 44x44 close hit area (testID product-coa-close). Uses expo-image, no HTML tags. Safe-area insets respected.

src/api/glp/coa.ts — fetchCoaFile hits /products/{id}/coa through the authenticated glpFetch client (same bearer→X-GLP-Customer-Token header the rest of the app uses). mapCoa guards: non-object → null; 'url' type requires a non-empty string; 'file' type coerces mime/name to strings. openCoaPdf uses expo-file-system/legacy writeAsStringAsync + expo-sharing on native, Blob+URL.createObjectURL on web. No public URLs on our domain are ever constructed.

src/api/glp/catalogue.ts — mapProduct now sets `coa: mapCoa(p?.coa)` on EVERY product (line 106). When upstream omits `coa` (plugin v2.3.0), p?.coa is undefined → mapCoa returns null → CoaSection renders nothing. Verified at runtime: /api/glp/catalogue response has NO `coa` key on any of the 3 products returned.

src/api/glp/manage.ts — ProductEdit has coa_file / coa_name / coa_url / coa_remove fields (lines 20-22). ManagedProduct carries `coa?: ProductCoa | null` only when upstream includes it (line 36 `p?.coa !== undefined ? mapCoa(p.coa) : undefined`) so the editor's remove button correctly stays hidden on products that never had a COA.

app/manage/product/[id].tsx — the editor's save() flow does the four confirmation dialogs in the correct order: (1) UNPUBLISH confirm when p.status was 'publish' and f.publish becomes false; (2) 'Mark as sold out?' confirm when stock reaches 0 from a previously-available state (zeroNow && wasAvailable); (3) 'Remove COA?' confirm when coaRemove is true; (4) member suspend uses the same confirmAction pattern in /app/frontend/app/manage/members/[id].tsx (not inspected here but same util). The COA card (testID manage-coa) shows the current state line (manage-coa-current), Upload file button, conditional Remove button (hidden when no COA exists AND no new one is being added), and the URL input; coaFile/coaUrl/coaRemove are mutually exclusive (setting one clears the others). coa_name uses pickLabelFile('label') — note this reuses the SHIPPING-LABEL picker (PDF/JPG/PNG) which is appropriate; the comment inside pickCoa says 'label' is the kind — fine, but the user-facing error 'COA files must be a PDF, JPG or PNG up to 5 MB.' is correct.

src/utils/confirm.ts — cross-platform shim: web uses window.confirm (synchronous), native uses Alert.alert with a destructive style confirm button + cancel + onDismiss resolve(false). Promise-based so save() can `await` and short-circuit. Minimal and correct.

src/utils/product-photo.ts — pickProductPhoto compresses via expo-image-manipulator (SaveFormat.JPEG, compress 0.8, max side 1600px) with a 30 MB input ceiling. Returns { data: base64, name: '<base>.jpg', mime: 'image/jpeg' }. Keeps uploads tiny — matches the review requirement for staff photo auto-compression. Note: expo-image-manipulator is current (not deprecated); legacy FileSystem is only used inside coa.ts for the PDF export path.

backend/glp_proxy.py — GET /api/glp/products/{id}/coa (lines 215-217) is a one-liner that forwards to upstream /products/{id}/coa with the customer token (via X-GLP-Customer-Token) and the server secret. Correctly uses path validation (product_id typed as int). Response headers set to no-store/no-cache (line 116). The /api/glp/manage regex at line 332 does NOT cover /products/{id}/coa — correct, that's a customer route, not a manage route.

backend/connector-src/glp-app-connector/includes/coa.php — storage path tries /glp-private-coa OUTSIDE the web root first, falls back to uploads/glp-coa with .htaccess 'Require all denied' + index.php silence. File names are random (bin2hex(random_bytes(16)) + ext). Chmod 0640. 5 MB cap. mime-sniff via glp_detect_label_mime() + getimagesizefromstring for images, dedicated application/pdf path. REST route re-uses glp_authed_user_or_error + glp_guard_approved + GLP_PRIVATE_PRODUCT_META === 'yes' + status === 'publish' — same gate as the catalogue. X-Robots-Tag noindex,nofollow on the response. Woo duplicate hook strips the file reference (so a duplicated product doesn't silently share a private file). All three PHP files: php -l clean.

No deprecated expo packages introduced: expo-image-manipulator, expo-document-picker, expo-sharing, expo-file-system/legacy, expo-web-browser — all current. (expo-file-system/legacy is intentional per Expo SDK >=52 guidance; no expo-av, no expo-barcode-scanner, no expo-background-fetch anywhere in these files.)

success_rate.backend: 4/4 pytest cases pass (health, coa-route-unauth, coa-route-authed→upstream 404 rest_no_route expected, catalogue has no coa field yet). php -l clean on coa.php/manage.php/emails.php. Live upstream connector v2.3.0 → COA endpoint 404 is EXPECTED and matches review notes.
success_rate.frontend: 8/9 review-request UI checks pass on preview: (a) login+tabs OK, (b) home hero 'Members-only stock, while it lasts' + 'Browse products' + home-support-card thepentarchy@proton.me, (c) shop top bar 'Available now', (d) product-screen renders normally with 0 occurrences of product-coa-section (correct — no COA upstream), (e) 'Ask a question' absent, (f) account has no Legal / no Help & contact, (g) account-contact-email row shows 'Email us | thepentarchy@proton.me', (h) basket→checkout reaches place-order-button (not pressed). ONE partial fail: 'no customer-visible Vial/AP3P/Apeps/GLP' — Home/Account/Checkout clean, but Shop filter chip + Product category eyebrow still read 'Vials'/'VIALS' because the WooCommerce category is literally named 'Vials' upstream.

seed_data_creation: No seed data created. No orders placed. No labels uploaded. No COA uploads (staff login unavailable — password unknown this iteration, per review request skip live staff E2E). An ephemeral 1-item basket was added to r30 to reach the checkout screen then abandoned (not placed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://apeps-mobile-demo.preview.emergentagent.com; customer login tracktest.ap3p@mailinator.com / TrackTest2026! works and returns ~104-char bearer. Tab testIDs: tab-home, tab-shop, tab-search, tab-orders, tab-account (NOT tab-vials). Live WP plugin is still v2.3.0 — /api/glp/products/{id}/coa therefore returns 404 rest_no_route and /api/glp/catalogue response has no `coa` field; both are expected per this iteration's review. CoaSection correctly renders nothing in that state. When the operator installs plugin v2.4.0, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_glp_coa_proxy.py to verify the 200-with-coa and 404-glp_no_coa branches. For live staff E2E (editor confirm dialogs, COA upload, member suspend) the staff password for test@test.com needs to be re-shared by the user — the current creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md still return 401 from WP. Avoid using page.click(force=True) on checkout radio rows at 390x844; the sticky Place-order CTA overlaps them — use dispatch_event('click').
rca_of_issue: No regressions. Two tracked user-content caveats: (1) 'Vials' still visible in customer UI = WooCommerce category name on prod WP, not an app bug. Fix at either the WP admin level (rename category) OR add a client-side override map in /app/frontend/src/api/glp/catalogue.ts mapProduct().categories. (2) Account 'Data source' badge shows 'MOCK DATA' when EXPO_PUBLIC_DATA_SOURCE=glp — ternary in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/account.tsx:99-100 only checks for 'live'. Change `activeDataSource === 'live'` to `activeDataSource !== 'mock'` (or add an explicit 'glp' arm) to show 'LIVE' / 'GLP' when connected to the live GLP backend.
